title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Code Blocks in M365 Copilot
description: M365 Copilot now supports code blocks, which lets you preview code, charts, diagrams, and more directly inline while using Chat. Previously, users could preview code side-by-side in a code canvas.
